as_told.title: Carl Nell points people to Jesse's Townsend Brown videos

plain: Karl Nell, a former defence industry executive, has told people that to understand the unusual flying technology behind UFO reports, they should watch Michels's video on the researcher Thomas Townsend Brown, Michels says. He tells it twice, once about a talk with a guest who flew helicopters and once later, adding that Nell had run a business with a $2 billion budget and was chief technology officer of a company belonging to the defence firm Northrop. Michels brings it up because it would mean a well-placed insider sees Brown's work on unusual propulsion as the right lead.
